question: Should `2026.7.1-2` be promoted to the setup LKG after the reported startup-risk disposition and the requested Windows/WSL acceptance matrix are supplied?
rationale: Calling a version “last known good” is a release-quality assertion; source review cannot determine whether the candidate is acceptable across supported installation and recovery paths.

options.title: Require acceptance evidence
options.body: Keep the draft open until a release owner documents the upstream-risk disposition and reviews redacted current-head Windows/WSL acceptance output for exactly `2026.7.1-2`.

options.title: Accept the promotion risk
options.body: Merge with a documented release-owner rationale that the remaining startup-risk uncertainty is acceptable for this LKG update.

recommendation.title: Require acceptance evidence
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until a release owner documents the upstream-risk disposition and reviews redacted current-head Windows/WSL acceptance output for exactly `2026.7.1-2`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review explicitly defines the release-acceptance evidence and decision required for this promotion.
